name: minecraft-grpc-client
description: Typed Node.js client for the Minecraft gRPC mod

scripts.prebuild: proto-loader-gen-types --longs=String --enums=String --defaults --oneofs --includeComments --grpcLib=@grpc/grpc-js -I ../src/main/proto -O src/generated minecraft/grpc/v1/batch.proto minecraft/grpc/v1/common.proto minecraft/grpc/v1/entity.proto minecraft/grpc/v1/events.proto minecraft/grpc/v1/player.proto minecraft/grpc/v1/registry.proto minecraft/grpc/v1/server.proto minecraft/grpc/v1/structure.proto minecraft/grpc/v1/world.proto
